Horayot expressly has Zeira in Rav Hamnuna’s name in interpreting a teaching as Rabbi Meir’s view.
Yerushalmi Beitzah expressly has Zerikan in Zeira’s name about conveying ownership of the cooked dish.
Demai and Challah show Chaggai physically supporting Zeira in the paired wood-chip stories. These occurrences do not describe ordination. The question clause needs a separately matched occurrence.
Chiyya bar Bun appears alongside Zeira and Adda bar Tachlifa in a transmission from Rav Oshaya. Preserve the bare roster relationship.
The Bavli explicitly gives the chain Yirmeyah from Zeira, Zeira from Chiyya bar Ashi, and Chiyya bar Ashi from Rav.
Terumot explicitly has Zeira visiting Chiyya son of Yitzchak Atushaya. It qualifies the son’s report even while firmly attesting the named visit.
In the Knot chapter Zeira asks Chiyya bar Ba about wording prayers on Shabbat. Berakhot’s separate shared meal is pinned in the first receipt.
The Bavli has Rav Chanin reporting Rav Zeira. Preserve the titulature difference from the roster’s Rabbi Chanin.
The Bavli supplies two chains. In the second, Rabbi Zeira reports Rabbi Chanina, while the first has Rav Dimi transmit the same teaching.
Terumot names Chanina of Anatot traveling with Zeira to Chammat Gader. The roster leaves their relation implicit.
Megillah gives Zeira from Rav Chananel as a competing attribution, and elsewhere gives both reporting Rav. Keep the report and the joint chain apart.
The Yerushalmi expressly has Zeira in Rav Yehudah’s name on warming something to a temperature the hand can tolerate.
The Sotah chapter twice has Yehudah ben Pazi report Zeira. One concerns parallel rules of testimony and the other what counts as a corpse.
The Ketubot Af Al Pi chapter gives Zeira in Yochanan’s name on the beginning and end of the period. This supplies one named chapter. The other quoted chapter locator requires a closer result.
Kilayim explicitly gives Yochanan in Zeira’s name alongside Nicha bar Sava. This direction differs from the adjacent transmission from Yochanan.
Yerushalmi Ketubot has two opposing rulings linked to Zeira and Rabbi Yonatan with different transmitting partners. This checks the Af Al Pi locus. The Kilayim counterpart remains separate.
Challah’s matching narrative is numbered 3:5:3 in this witness and says Yose was giving physical support. Ketubot explicitly has Zeira ask Yasa about the practice of the court.
Berakhot expressly places Zeira and Yaakov bar Zavdi together and gives a direct response after Yaakov spat. The chapter and halakhah identify the received folio reference.
Maaser Sheni attests Yaakov bar Acha reporting Zeira. Sotah and Gittin attest a separate encounter with Yitzchak Atushaya. The middle Yaakov bar Adda bar Atalya attribution needs a distinct locus.
Maasrot and Nazir both give Maysha speaking or asking directly to Zeira. Both are safe occurrence-level comparisons.
Megillah places Menashe before Zeira. When Menashe dozes, Zeira tells him to go back because he did not attend properly.
Kilayim has Zeira and Yasa reporting Rav Mattana together about the allowance for a large and small vineyard.
Yerushalmi Taanit says Zeira sent to Nachum, at the place of Yannai son of Yishmael, about the abbreviated amidah. This provides the actual direction of the question.
Ketubot 4:13:2 directly names both interlocutors. The checked digital numbering is halakhah 13, against Heilprin’s 14. Preserve the received locator alongside the digital link.
Both Yerushalmi passages explicitly name Nikomakhi reciting before Zeira that there is no minimum quantity of recollected bones.
Ketubot gives Zeira and Ulla in the same chain with a parenthesized version of the link to Yishmael. Retain the unforced sparse roster wording.
Chagigah names Zeira and Ulla bar Yishmael in a common report. Maaser Sheni reports the dream and direct conversation. The roster does not specify which occurrence.
Kiddushin gives bar Pedayah in a question rather than an unmediated report from a plain Pedayah. The separate plain-name occurrence remains unlocalized.
Kiddushin supplies the name bar Pedayah in another form of the question. The intervening relay in this witness is Adda bar Achva.
Beitzah gives Zeira asking Kalla of the south directly about condytum. This identifies the person named without joining other occurrences of Kalla.
Nedarim explicitly has Shimon the judge reciting before Zeira on revoking abandonment of property.
Terumot gives Zeira and Shimon bar Abba together in a transmission from Yochanan. No hierarchy follows.
Two Bavli loci have Shemayah bar Zeira without ayin. Chullin, Eruvin and Bava Metzia have the form with ayin. The edition keeps both forms.

Heilprin’s Introduction discusses this same comparison and calls into question the Assi reading for the second question. It also points out that reporting in someone’s name does not always show direct discipleship.
The checked sources vary among Assi/Yasa and Yose in the questions. None can determine the global nonfinding concerning the other Zeira. Retain the limitation in the compiler’s voice.

The general pointer to Yehudah Nesia remains unlocalized. The checked Berakhot passage reports Zeira reading as priest in the Levite’s place, and contains no basis for identifying him independently. The exact Sedeh Yehoshua commentary retrieval failed.
The Demai text expressly has Abba bar Zemina reporting Zeira on the earlier generations. Preserve the form Zemini in the pinned source while marking the Zemina form in the witness.
Neither the two Buns in Shekalim nor Bun bar Chiyya in Nazir identifies the Avin of this bare roster mention.

The Rabbi Idi entry points to the chain in Terumot. The consulted Terumot reads Adda bar Gershon, named alongside Zeira in a report. It is a comparator for the variant, not grounds to substitute for Idi.

The adjacent context asks who Adda bar Avimi’s teacher was and Hezekiah answers Rabbi Zeira. This is the exact support for the reported studenthood. Heilprin’s separate Adda entry points to the same exchange.
The actual end of Shekalim 4 explicitly has Zeira reporting Rabbi Elazar, whom Heilprin expands as Elazar ben Pedat. The digital passage bears the unqualified name.
The pointed Assi entry reports the school relation with Yochanan. The local address Rabbi is clear in the parallel, while the stated master relationship belongs to the compilation.

The pointed Bibi paragraph discusses Zeira’s report and the Bar Avin/Bar Abaye reading. Berakhiah occurs in the already checked Taanit chain. The exact two received locators for Bun remain held. Other checked sources document repeated direct questions by Bun and need not be made the link targets here.

Ketubot has the chain Rav Dimi, Zeiri, Rabbi Chanina, followed by a shorter alternative starting with Zeiri. The locus omits Dimi’s patronymic and has Zeiri rather than Zeira. Keep the compiler’s spelling and the patronymic as in the source.
The Sukkah passage exactly has Zeira send his question to Daniel son of Rav Katina about the willow ritual.
In Demai Chaggai sends a question to Zeira about gentile tenants and tithing. Zeira asks Ammi in turn. This is separate from Chaggai’s physical support in the wood-chip story.

Berakhot has Rabbi Zeira prefer the report of Chiyya bar Abba for his care in transmitting a teaching. This does not independently establish that the bare Chiyya in this roster is the same person or that he was Zeira’s formal teacher.

The exact Megillah passage has Chiyya son of Adda of Jaffa and Yirmeyah in a joint report in Zeira’s name about reading the list of kings in a single breath. The patronym spelling differs from Heilprin’s Acha.
The pointed Rabbi Yonah entry repeats both transmitted classroom configurations from Bekhorot. The comparison is limited to those clauses.
Kiddushin expressly gives Yose son of Rabbi Bun reporting Zeira about the legal force of presumptions. It also attributes the claims about execution and burning to their respective speakers.
Yosa is named alongside Zeira in one of the competing transmissions about Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah’s ruling. The bare roster name leaves the intended encounter open.

The checked Shabbat names Zeira, Yannai and Yirmeyah together in the report from Yehoshua ben Levi about a cloth piece. It provides a distinct comparable occurrence, while the roster leaves their relationship bare.
The pointed Marinna entry cites chapter 7, but the checked wording is in Berakhot 6:1:17 and says Marinnah blessed before Zeira and Chiyya bar Va. Preserve the mismatch and identify the occurrence.
Kilayim explicitly has Nicha bar Sava and Yochanan in Zeira’s name, confirming the report direction. The pointed entry quotes the same locus.
The named digital witness reads Avoy de-Rav Safra in the question about tying a garment with thread of another material. This directly supports the wording ‘Rav Safra’s father’ for the witness.
Ulla the stonemason is named as the reciter before Dosa. Zeira tells him to preserve the fish-egg teaching and supplies a reason. This directly supports the exchange.
Makkot explicitly has Zeira in Mar Ukva’s name on measuring with a fifty-cubit rope. It distinguishes the following report in Rav Chisda’s name.
Taanit names Pelipha bar Perita objecting before Zeira with the Amalek passage. The precise spellings differ from the pinned Heilprin entry.
The Yerushalmi explicitly has Zeira hide from Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak when the latter dances before the bride. This is separate from his reluctance to be ordained.
